P_0x000946: Pilot of Cybuster, the <Masoukishin> of Wind. Impulsive and just, a natural athlete, but hopeless with directions. A Japanese youth summoned to the Holy Kingdom of Langran in the underground world <La Gias> to avert a god's prophesied calamity.
P_0x000ADC: Only daughter of <DC> leader Bian Zoldark. Superhuman athleticism, reflexes, and eyesight. A pretty but headstrong tomboy, weak to flattery. Loves obscure Japanese period dramas; saving money is her hobby.
P_0x000C30: Pilot of the <Masoukishin> Granveil. An ex-gym teacher who loves quoting the classics; a bit narcissistic and arrogant. Expert in Chinese kenpo, above all Northern Shaolin.
P_0x000D6C: Pilot of the <Masoukishin> Gaddess. Honest, quick to tears, but rarely shows it. Strong-willed and steady. Loves sweets, skiing, and cars.
P_0x000E63: A girl summoned from the surface world. Looks like an ordinary girl, even a bit young, yet is surprisingly mature - though her constant clowning rarely lets it show. An aikido master adept with ki, and a little vain.
P_0x001003: Only daughter of Zeoroot Zan Zenosakis, the Langran sword master who took Masaki in; she adored him like a brother, and became his stepsister when Zeoroot adopted him. Mature for her age, with real magical talent. Zeoroot's swordplay is etched into her from years of watching. A fine cook; Japanese dishes learned from Masaki are her specialty.
